title: Swarala Koyila 🎤🤣| Part 14| #itsmanaswini #comedy #funny #shorts
description:
Shravanamasam vratam with Honey 😂🙏

It starts with Honey getting woken up early by her mom, only to find out that it’s Shravanamasam Friday vratam! After getting ready, Honey sees plates full of delicious food and gets super excited… until Amma tells her to give everything to the neighbours! 😂😭

And just when Honey thinks she can finally eat something, Amma reminds her that she’s not supposed to eat all day because of the vratam! 😭😂

Then the relatives start coming over for vayanam, and Honey tries her best to hide because she knows exactly what’s coming… someone is definitely going to ask her to sing! 😂🎶

Watch till the end to see what happens when Honey gets asked to sing… and then gets asked to sing AGAIN! 😂

A fun and relatable Shravanamasam family comedy with vratam, vayanam, relatives and, of course, Honey’s singing! ❤️
